title: B1  System context and external boundaries
caption: Implementation view from S3, S4 and S6. Financial settlement remains inside the project ledger; provider calls leave the local stack.

title: B2  Deployment domains and shared network
caption: Grouped deployment view from infra/compose. Boxes represent service groups, not one container each. The OCR worker is created per invocation.

title: B3  Agent orchestration and human review
caption: Implementation view from graph.py and agent nodes. The critic is called within Approval. Rejection and unsafe input end the graph; human review uses a durable interrupt.

title: B4  Identity boundaries and credential brokering
caption: Implementation view from identity.py, ledger_client.py and the agent runtime. Universal Auth tokens are cached until shortly before expiry; the ledger API key is fetched fresh for each ledger request.

title: B5  Authorization and decision overrides
caption: Implementation view from capability.py, policy_client.py and policy-service/app/main.py. The order shown is the policy service decision pipeline for checked actions.

title: B6  Invoice data lifecycle and privacy boundaries
caption: Implementation view from main.py, graph.py, extraction.py and pii.py. A successful redaction test covers the tested audit text; it does not establish protection for every durable data path.

title: B7  Model routing and prompt promotion
caption: Implementation view from llm_clients.py, agent nodes, litellm/config.yaml, extraction.py and eval_gate.py. Thresholds shown are source defaults; no fresh evaluation was run.

title: B8  Payment settlement and duplicate protection
caption: Implementation view from payment_execution.py, ledger_client.py and ledger.py. Scenario 19 verified a stop during the hold with no ledger movement.

title: B9  OCR execution and nested isolation
caption: Implementation view from sandbox-runner/app/main.py and sandbox-ocr/ocr.py. Scenario 11 verified Docker isolation but could not verify Landlock on the reported kernel.

title: B10  Audit append verification and recovery
caption: Implementation view from audit-log/app/main.py. MinIO is written before the Postgres transaction commits; this is ordered application logic, not a distributed atomic transaction. Restoring original object bytes is an operator action.

title: B11  Traces metrics and operational dashboards
caption: Implementation view from tracing.py, prometheus.yml and the observability Compose layer. The configured Prometheus jobs are policy-service and LiteLLM.

title: B12  Stop triggers and enforcement points
caption: Implementation view from control-plane/app/main.py, policy-service and control_plane_client.py. Reported scenarios 13, 14 and 19 cover manual stops, automatic stops and interruption during settlement hold.
